target.class_name: Anh văn chuyên ngành Cơ khí
target.lesson_title: Chapter 3: Hand Tools — Dụng cụ cầm tay

exam.title: Kiểm tra từ vựng Chapter 3: Hand Tools

questions.question: Which English word means “tua vít đầu chữ thập (bốn cạnh)”?
questions.explanation: phillips screwdriver: A screwdriver for a screw with a cross-shape on the head.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A hand tool for gripping, pulling and cutting.
questions.explanation: pliers = kìm.

questions.question: Which English word means “cây cậy lốp”?
questions.explanation: tire levers: Tools used to take a tire off a wheel.

questions.question: Which English word means “máy phun sơn”?
questions.explanation: paint-sprayer: A tool that sprays paint onto a surface.

questions.question: Which English word means “kìm cắt chéo”?
questions.explanation: diagonal cutters: Pliers with angled edges for cutting wire.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A manual device used for home improvement projects.
questions.explanation: hand tool = dụng cụ cầm tay.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A hand tool that turns screws.
questions.explanation: screwdriver = tua vít.

questions.question: Which English word means “búa nhổ đinh”?
questions.explanation: claw hammer: A hammer that can drive in or remove nails.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A tool that removes the plastic cover from a wire.
questions.explanation: wire strippers = kìm tuốt dây điện.

questions.question: What does flashlight mean?
options: kìm cắt cạnh (cắt dây sát bề mặt)
questions.explanation: flashlight = đèn pin.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A tool with a long flexible ruler for measuring length.
questions.explanation: tape measure = thước cuộn.

questions.question: What does spanner mean?
questions.explanation: spanner = cờ lê miệng (cách gọi của Anh, cùng nghĩa wrench).

questions.question: Which English word means “dao rọc giấy, dao đa dụng”?
questions.explanation: utility knife: A small cutting device with a retractable blade.

questions.question: Which English word means “kìm mở được hai cỡ (khớp trượt)”?
questions.explanation: slip-joint pliers: Pliers that are adjustable.

questions.question: Which English word means “thụt vào được, kéo vào được”?
questions.explanation: retractable: Being able to pull back in.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
Pliers with needle-like pincers.
questions.explanation: long-nose pliers = kìm mũi nhọn dài.

questions.question: What does measuring tape mean?
questions.explanation: measuring tape = thước cuộn (cùng nghĩa tape measure).

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A screwdriver for a screw with a flat slot.
questions.explanation: flathead screwdriver = tua vít đầu dẹt.

questions.question: Which English word means “đồ ngũ kim”?
questions.explanation: hardware: Metal tools and equipment, such as screws and hammers.

questions.question: What does side cutters mean?
options: kìm cắt cạnh (cắt dây sát bề mặt)
questions.explanation: side cutters = kìm cắt cạnh (cắt dây sát bề mặt).

questions.question: Which English word means “cờ lê”?
questions.explanation: wrench: A hand tool that tightens and loosens nuts and bolts.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
Being able to change sizes.
questions.explanation: adjustable = chỉnh được, thay đổi cỡ được.

questions.question: What does wheel balancer mean?
questions.explanation: wheel balancer = máy cân bằng bánh xe.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A set of tools kept together in one box.
questions.explanation: tool kit = bộ dụng cụ (hộp đựng nhiều dụng cụ).

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A tool that pushes grease into machine parts.
questions.explanation: grease gun = súng bơm mỡ.
